messages.content: "你能幫我創作一首D小調、每分鐘120拍的音樂，然後產生一個頻率為440赫茲、振幅為0.5的音訊訊號嗎？之後，我想要創作另一首E大調、每分鐘90拍、拍子記號為3/4的音樂。最後，產生另一個頻率為300赫茲、振幅為0.7、持續5秒的音訊訊號。"

function.name: audio_generate
function.description: Generate an audio signal given a frequency, amplitude, and duration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

frequency.description: Frequency of the audio signal in Hz.

amplitude.description: Amplitude of the audio signal. This is a float type value.

duration.description: Duration of the audio signal in seconds. Default is 1 second if not specified. This is a float type value.

function.name: music_generate
function.description: Generate a piece of music given a key, tempo, and time signature. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

key.description: The key of the piece, e.g., C Major.

tempo.description: Tempo of the piece in beats per minute.

time_signature.description: Time signature of the piece, e.g., 4/4. Default is '4/4' if not specified.

message.reasoning:
The user wants us to do two things:

1. Create a piece of music with key D minor, tempo 120 bpm, default time signature (4/4). Then generate an audio signal with frequency 440 Hz, amplitude 0.5, default duration 1 second.

2. Create another piece of music with key E major, tempo 90 bpm, time signature 3/4. Then generate another audio signal with frequency 300 Hz, amplitude 0.7, duration 5 seconds.

We have two tools: music_generate and audio_generate. We need to call them twice each. The user wants us to produce the results. We should call music_generate twice: first with key "D minor", tempo 120, no time_signature. Second with key "E major", tempo 90, time_signature "3/4". Then call audio_generate twice: first with frequency 440, amplitude 0.5, no duration. Second with frequency 300, amplitude 0.7, duration 5.

We need to output the calls to the tool. The user didn't ask for anything else. So we just call the tools. We'll do it sequentially. We'll call music_generate first, then audio_generate, then music_generate again, then audio_generate again. We'll use the tool calls.
